title: Module 7 · Lesson 2 — Putting the stack together

lines: Module Seven, Lesson Two: putting the stack together.
The exam loves end-to-end designs, so let's build one.
Picture a hospital network whose nurses ask an assistant about clinical guidelines.
The first draft, one big model on one GPU, aces the pilot.

say.1: The first draft, one big model on one G P U, aces the pilot.

lines: Then three hundred nurses log on at once, and the GPU runs out of memory.
And patient data must never leave the hospital.

say.0: Then three hundred nurses log on at once, and the G P U runs out of memory.

lines: The rebuild starts with a stateless agent service on Kubernetes.
It scales out on the number of in-flight requests.
Inside, a NeMo Agent Toolkit workflow runs the loop, with profiling and tracing.
NeMo Guardrails adds input, dialog, retrieval, execution and output rails.

say.0: Inside, a Neemo Agent Toolkit workflow runs the loop, with profiling and tracing.
say.1: Neemo Guardrails adds input, dialog, retrieval, execution and output rails.

lines: The agent calls an LLM NIM that scales on queue depth, with two warm copies.
Embedding and reranking NIMs from NeMo Retriever feed a Milvus vector database.

say.0: The agent calls an L L M nim that scales on queue depth, with two warm copies.
say.1: Embedding and reranking nims from Neemo Retriever feed a Mil-vus vector database.

lines: Tools come through MCP servers and internal APIs.
Postgres and Redis hold state; OpenTelemetry traces feed observability.

say.0: Tools come through M C P servers and internal A P Is.
say.1: Postgres and Reddis hold state; Open Telemetry traces feed observability.

lines: Offline, production traces flow through Curator, Customizer and Evaluator.
A new model then moves from shadow, to canary, to full rollout.
Now hardware: does the model fit in one GPU at your chosen precision?
Count weights plus KV cache for your target concurrency.

say.0: Now hardware: does the model fit in one G P U at your chosen precision?
say.1: Count weights plus K V cache for your target concurrency.

lines: If not, NVLink makes tensor parallelism worthwhile.
And many small models can share fewer GPUs, with hard isolation, using MIG.

say.0: If not, en-vee link makes tensor parallelism worthwhile.
say.1: And many small models can share fewer G P Us, with hard isolation, using mig.

lines: That's where the first draft went wrong: it was sized for weights alone.
With long agent runs at high concurrency, the KV cache can rival or exceed them.

say.1: With long agent runs at high concurrency, the K V cache can rival or exceed them.

lines: When data must never leave, the entire stack is self-hosted.
NIM containers come from NGC into a private registry; the NIM Operator caches models on a PVC.

say.1: Nim containers come from N G C into a private registry; the nim Operator caches models on a P V C.

lines: The vector database is self-hosted too, and no tool calls an external API.
This is one of NIM's main reasons to exist.

say.0: The vector database is self-hosted too, and no tool calls an external A P I.
say.1: This is one of nim's main reasons to exist.

lines: Exam tip: air-gapped framing recurs in regulated-industry questions, and capacity plans must include the KV cache.
